info.name: 🏥 System
info.description:
## 🏥 System & observability

Public endpoints for load balancers and ops.

### Health

`GET /api/health` — Liveness/readiness: runs `SELECT 1` on PostgreSQL and `PING` on Redis. Returns **200** with `status: ok` when both pass; **503** with `status: error` and per-check `checks.database` / `checks.redis` (`ok` | `down`) when any dependency fails.

No authentication required.

request.description: Verifies PostgreSQL and Redis. Response body includes `status`, `timestamp`, and `checks` with `database` and `redis` each `ok` or `down`. HTTP **503** when any check is down.
